description: Use this when the user wants printable recipe cards ("recipe card", "recipe cards printable", "4x6 recipe card", "recipe card template", "3x5 recipe cards", "print my recipe on a card") or wants a recipe doubled, halved or scaled to a number of servings for printing. If the user pastes or uploads a recipe (text, a web page or a photo of a card), first copy its title, servings, ingredient lines and steps into recipes, keeping amounts as written, then call. Builds a PDF of 4x6, 3x5, 5x7, half-letter or A6 cards, up to 4 per Letter or A4 sheet with cut lines or one per page, scales amounts with fractions kept as fractions, converts units only when asked, and continues long recipes on a second card instead of shrinking text below 8 pt. Returns the scaled ingredient lines, card counts and a PDF link. Does not find or invent recipes, does not compute nutrition, and does not change cooking times.

color.description: Accent colour: hex like #C2410C or a name (terracotta, red, rose, berry, purple, blue, navy, teal, green, sage, olive, mustard, brown, slate, black). Default terracotta.

from.description: Optional footer name, printed as "From the kitchen of <name>", e.g. "Grandma Rose".

ingredients.description: Only when sending one recipe without the recipes list: its ingredient lines.

orientation.description: landscape (default for 4x6, 3x5, 5x7) or portrait (default for half-letter and A6).

paper.description: letter (default; 2 to 4 cards per sheet with cut lines), a4, or card (one card per page at true size, for card stock). Default a4 for A6 cards.

recipe_text.description: Fallback: a whole recipe pasted as plain text (title on the first line, then Ingredients and Instructions sections). Use recipes when you can.

ingredients.description: Ingredient lines exactly as written, one per item, e.g. ["1 1/2 cups flour", "2 large eggs", "salt to taste"]. A line ending with a colon ("For the glaze:") prints as a sub-heading.

notes.description: Optional tip printed after the steps.

scale.description: Optional factor for this recipe only, e.g. 2, 0.5 or "1 1/2".

scale_to.description: Optional target servings for this recipe only, e.g. 12.

servings.description: How many the recipe as written serves or makes, e.g. 8 or "makes 24 cookies". Needed for scaling to servings.

steps.description: Method steps in order, one sentence or paragraph each, without numbers, e.g. ["Heat the oven to 350°F.", "Mash the bananas."].

ingredients.description: Ingredient lines exactly as written, one per item, e.g. ["1 1/2 cups flour", "2 large eggs", "salt to taste"]. A line ending with a colon ("For the glaze:") prints as a sub-heading.

notes.description: Optional tip printed after the steps.

scale.description: Optional factor for this recipe only, e.g. 2, 0.5 or "1 1/2".

scale_to.description: Optional target servings for this recipe only, e.g. 12.

servings.description: How many the recipe as written serves or makes, e.g. 8 or "makes 24 cookies". Needed for scaling to servings.

steps.description: Method steps in order, one sentence or paragraph each, without numbers, e.g. ["Heat the oven to 350°F.", "Mash the bananas."].

recipes.description: The recipes, one object each with title, servings, ingredients and steps. If the user pasted or photographed a recipe, copy its title, servings, ingredient lines and steps into these fields first; keep amounts exactly as written.

scale.description: Scale every recipe by this factor instead: 2 (double), 0.5 (half), 1.5 or "3/4". Amounts stay fractions, e.g. 3/4 cup x 2 = 1 1/2 cups.

scale_to.description: Same as servings: the target number of servings, e.g. 12.

servings.description: Scale every recipe to this many servings, e.g. 12. Each recipe needs its own servings to scale from.

steps.description: Only when sending one recipe without the recipes list: its steps.

title.description: Only when sending one recipe without the recipes list: its name.

units.description: keep (default, amounts as written), metric (ml, l, g, kg) or us (cups, tbsp, tsp, oz, lb). Converts volume to volume and weight to weight only.

name: generate_recipe_cards
title: Generate recipe cards
